name: next-webpack
description: Minimal Next.js app instrumented with @posthog/nextjs-config. `start` builds with webpack (the plugin uploads source maps per compilation) and probes a server route that captures an exception; `start:releaseless` runs the same on --release-mode=event, where the CLI injects release ids and adopts native debug ids when Next's vendored webpack supports them.

scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm probe
scripts.start:releaseless: pnpm clean && pnpm build:releaseless && pnpm probe
